description: This file defines a JSONStorage class for thread-safe management of JSON data files, including methods for loading, saving, appending, updating, and filtering data, with logging support.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: Manages thread-safe JSON file operations such as load, save, append, update, get by id, and filter

methods.name: __init__(self, cache_path: Path)
methods.description: Initializes JSONStorage with a cache path and creates directories if needed

methods.name: Path _get_file_path(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Returns the full path for a given filename, appending .json if missing

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] load(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file; returns an empty list if file does not exist or error occurs

methods.name: bool save(self, filename: str, data: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Saves data to a JSON file; returns True if successful

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append(self, filename: str, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Appends an item to the JSON file, adding metadata 'id' and 'created_at'

methods.name: bool update(self, filename: str, item_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing item by id with provided updates; adds 'updated_at' timestamp

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, filename: str, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its id from the JSON file

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] filter(self, filename: str, **filters)
methods.description: Filters items based on key-value criteria

ctags.name: append
ctags.pattern: /^    def append(self, filename: str, item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    def filter(self, filename: str, **filters) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: get_by_id
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_by_id(self, filename: str, item_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: load
ctags.pattern: /^    def load(self, filename: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: save
ctags.pattern: /^    def save(self, filename: str, data: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, filename: str, item_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:$/
